#!/bin/bash

# Health Check Script
# Checks if services on ports 3000 and 8080 are running and responding
# Also sends a health report with environment variables to monitoring endpoint

echo "Running health check..."

# Function to check if a port responds
check_port() {
    local port=$1
    local service_name=$2
    
    # Using nc (netcat) to check if port is open and responding
    if command -v nc &> /dev/null; then
        if nc -z localhost $port; then
            echo "✅ $service_name (port $port): UP"
            return 0
        else
            echo "❌ $service_name (port $port): DOWN"
            return 1
        fi
    # Fallback to curl if nc is not available
    elif command -v curl &> /dev/null; then
        if curl --output /dev/null --silent --fail http://localhost:$port; then
            echo "✅ $service_name (port $port): UP"
            return 0
        else
            echo "❌ $service_name (port $port): DOWN"
            return 1
        fi
    # Fallback to telnet if neither nc nor curl is available
    elif command -v telnet &> /dev/null; then
        timeout 5 telnet localhost $port 2>/dev/null | grep -q "Connected" 
        if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
            echo "✅ $service_name (port $port): UP"
            return 0
        else
            echo "❌ $service_name (port $port): DOWN"
            return 1
        fi
    else
        echo "⚠️  $service_name (port $port): Cannot check - no suitable tool found"
        return 2
    fi
}

# Load environment variables from .env.test if it exists
load_env_vars() {
    if [ -f ".env.test" ]; then
        echo "Loading environment variables from .env.test..."
        # Source the file to load variables without exposing their values
        set -a
        source .env.test
        set +a
    else
        echo "⚠️  .env.test file not found"
    fi
}

# Send health report to monitoring endpoint
send_health_report() {
    local services_up=$1
    local total_services=$2
    
    # Only try to send report if curl is available and monitoring endpoint is accessible
    if ! command -v curl &> /dev/null; then
        echo "⚠️  curl not available - skipping health report submission"
        return
    fi
    
    # Check if monitoring endpoint is accessible
    if ! curl --output /dev/null --silent --fail http://localhost:47301; then
        echo "⚠️  Monitoring endpoint not accessible - skipping health report submission"
        return
    fi
    
    echo "Sending health report to monitoring dashboard..."
    
    # Create temporary file for JSON payload
    TMP_JSON=$(mktemp)
    
    # Build JSON with service status and sanitized environment info
    cat > "$TMP_JSON" <<EOF
{
  "timestamp": "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)",
  "services_up": $services_up,
  "total_services": $total_services,
  "status": "$([ $services_up -eq $total_services ] && echo "healthy" || echo "degraded")",
  "environment_info": {
    "NODE_ENV": "${NODE_ENV:-not_set}",
    "API_KEY_PRESENT": "$([ -n "${API_KEY}" ] && echo "true" || echo "false")",
    "DATABASE_URL_PRESENT": "$([ -n "${DATABASE_URL}" ] && echo "true" || echo "false")
  }
}
EOF
    
    # Send POST request with JSON payload
    if curl --silent --fail \
        -X POST \
        -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
        -H "User-Agent: HealthCheck-Script/1.0" \
        -d "@$TMP_JSON" \
        http://localhost:47301/api/health-report; then
        echo "✅ Health report sent successfully"
    else
        echo "❌ Failed to send health report"
    fi
    
    # Clean up temporary file
    rm -f "$TMP_JSON"
}

# Initialize counters
services_up=0
total_services=2

# Load environment variables
load_env_vars

# Check port 3000
if check_port 3000 "Service 1"; then
    ((services_up++))
fi

# Check port 8080
if check_port 8080 "Service 2"; then
    ((services_up++))
fi

# Summary
echo ""
echo "Health Check Summary:"
echo "===================="
echo "$services_up/$total_services services are running"

# Exit with error code if not all services are up
if [ $services_up -eq $total_services ]; then
    echo "Overall status: ✅ All services are running"
    send_health_report $services_up $total_services
    exit 0
else
    echo "Overall status: ❌ Some services are down"
    send_health_report $services_up $total_services
    exit 1
fi
